narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide professional dermatological advice regarding the use of Retinol (A醇) and Retinoic Acid (A酸) for patients suffering from specific skin conditions such as Atopic Dermatitis, Rosacea, and Seborrheic Dermatitis. The video aims to dispel myths by explaining that while these conditions require careful timing (not using active ingredients during flare-ups), long-term maintenance with these ingredients is beneficial for skin health and pore management.
